task: Implement validate_user for the login flow without importing registration validation logic.

candidate_memories.content: Login validate_user checks credentials against the hashed password and returns an auth token.
Login validation must reject locked accounts and log the attempt regardless of credential validity.
Failed login attempts must increment the lockout counter before returning the error response.
When validate_user spans login and registration, confirm the lockout and credential model first.
Registration: validate_user checks email format, password strength, and uniqueness before saving.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: registration uniqueness checks and strength rules are irrelevant to login validation

candidate_memories.content: Old auth note says user validation should be unified across registration and login for consistency.
